scope: Complete finite searches on x_i in {0,1/D,...,1}, with repetitions allowed. No conclusion for arbitrary rational denominators.
necessary_denominator_fact: The equality-case corollary forces odd denominators; moment integrality then forces a common denominator divisible by 15.
independent_cross_check: The less optimized search_degree4_magnitudes.cpp independently counted the same 2235 even-moment candidates for D=45 and rejected all sign assignments.
arithmetic: All enumeration, pruning, matching and moment verification use exact bounded integer arithmetic.
